name: Buy Me a Coffee

sources.title: Buy Me a Coffee homepage — creator funding platform with 'Start my page' (free, <1 minute), 'Search creators', Memberships and Shop features

requirements: Creator-oriented page ('Designed for creators, not for businesses') — accepts supporters, memberships, shop items, and posts
Sign-up at buymeacoffee.com/signup ('Start my page'); the batch's www.buymeacoffee.com/sign-up URL returned 404
Payments to the creator require a payout setup (bank account) — the page itself is free
preparation: Creator/page name and slug choice (pages live at buymeacoffee.com/<slug>)
Profile image, short bio, and the website/project URL to link
Optional: membership tiers, shop items (ebooks, 1:1 calls), and posts if using those features
workflow: Go to https://buymeacoffee.com/signup and create an account / 'Start my page'
Set the page slug, profile, description, and link to the product site
Publish posts or enable memberships/shop if desired
Share the public buymeacoffee.com/<slug> URL — it is indexable and appears in the site's creator search
watchFor: This is a creator-support profile, not a product directory — the SEO value is a profile page, not a categorized listing
BMC takes a platform fee on supporter payments (fund your work); not needed if the page is used purely as a profile
Pages are searchable via 'Search creators' but there's no curated launch board
countsAsLive: The public page at buymeacoffee.com/<slug> loads and is findable via the site's creator search
unknowns: Exact platform fee percentage and payout requirements
Whether external links on the page are followed/nofollowed
Whether inactive pages are ever removed
